author: Nio (Master)

profiles.strategy: one whole PDF page per chunk

token_unit_contract: Provider-neutral regex units: Unicode word sequences or individual non-whitespace punctuation. These are deterministic portable chunk units, not a claim about Gemini's private tokenizer.

queries.question: 哪一種植物的根莖及其樹脂在書中被記載用於習慣性便秘？
Which plant's rhizome and resin does the book describe as being used for habitual constipation?
這兩頁是否記載 Podophyllum peltatum 的染色體數目？

selection_rule: All answerable queries must rank a term-bearing page-192 chunk first.
The unanswerable query must remain blocked by the deterministic source-term gate.
All chunks must retain source_id and pdf_page and be exact substrings of the parent page.
Among passing profiles, maximize mean MRR, then recall@1, then the mean relevant-versus-nonrelevant cosine margin; exact ties prefer fewer chunks.
